<a name="route-resolvecontroller"></a>
### `Route::resolveController()`

```php
public static function resolveController($name)
```

Resolves the controller part of a 'Controller@action' route to a declared class name

- fully qualified names are accepted, with or without a leading backslash: 'Shop\OrderController', '\Shop\OrderController'
- a declared class always wins (a project's own global AIController is used as is)
- a short name that is not a declared class falls back to the framework example controllers namespace (Caligrafy\Controllers), so routes written before 1.6 such as 'AIController@query' keep working

**Parameters**

+ `$name` `string`: defines the controller part of the route

**Returns** `string|null`: the class name, or null when no such controller exists

Source: [framework/core/Route.php:263](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Route.php#L263)

<a name="route-capability"></a>
### `Route::capability()`

```php
public static function capability($method, $route, $name)
```

Maps a route to a capability (REST): Route::capability('POST', '/books', 'create_book')
The route variables ({id}) become inputs of the capability. See Caligrafy\Rest for the request and response format.

**Parameters**

+ `$method` `string`: GET, POST, PUT or DELETE
+ `$route` `string`: the uri
+ `$name` `string`: the capability name

<a name="route-page"></a>
### `Route::page()`

```php
public static function page($route, $view, array $options = array())
```

A page: renders a view through the framework's page controller, which gives every page who is signed in and,
optionally, an access rule and data from capabilities (pages never read models):

```
Route::page('/books', 'Books/index');
Route::page('/books/{id}', 'Books/show', ['data' => ['book' => 'get_book']]);
Route::page('/admin/books', 'Books/admin', ['level' => 1, 'data' => ['books' => 'list_books']]);
```

Options: 'signedIn' (bool), 'level' (int), 'data' (name =&gt; read-only capability, or [capability, inputs]),
'with' (fixed values), 'notFound' (a view shown with a 404 when a data capability finds nothing);
2.20.0: 'visitorsOnly' (a path: signed-in people are sent there), 'comeBack' (true: a visitor goes to
/login?return=&lt;this page&gt;), 'query' (the names of the query string the view gets)

**Parameters**

+ `$route` `string`: the uri
+ `$view` `string`: the view, as for view()
+ `$options` `array`, default `array()`: see PageController::render()

Source: [framework/core/Route.php:352](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Route.php#L352)

<a name="route-action"></a>
### `Route::action()`

```php
public static function action($route, $capability, array $options = array())
```

A request answered by a web-only capability (2.21.0, Caligrafy\Action): for what Route::page and Route::form
cannot say, such as a sign-in between two sites, a gate or a payment page. The capability is declared
#[Capability(..., webOnly: true)] and may return a Caligrafy\Web.

```
Route::action('/connect', 'cloud_connect');
Route::action('/unlock/{name}', 'unlock_app', ['method' => 'POST']);
```

Options: 'method' ('GET' by default, 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE' or a list), 'signedIn', 'level', 'comeBack',
'visitorsOnly' (as Route::page), 'back', 'error' and 'signIn' (as Route::form, for a refusal it does not answer)

**Parameters**

+ `$route`
+ `$capability`
+ `$options` `array`, default `array()`

Source: [framework/core/Route.php:377](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Route.php#L377)

<a name="route-snap"></a>
### `Route::snap()`

```php
public static function snap(array $options = array())
```

Snap Cards and the assistant (2.23.0, Caligrafy\Snap): every capability of the app as a card, and an assistant
that answers with them, in one line of web.php:

```
Route::snap();
Route::snap(['assistant' => '/help', 'cards' => '/cards']);
```

It declares, for the signed-in person:

```
/assistant              Home (what needs you, insights, things to browse, shortcuts) and the task space
/assistant/ask          what they typed, said, attached or clicked (snap_ask)
/assistant/noticed      what the assistant noticed, and their routines (a settings page)
/snap                   every card they may use (a gallery), /snap/c/{capability} one card at its own address
/snap/run, /snap/call/  a card sent (snap_run), and the snap_* capabilities the pages call
```

The tables come with php caligrafer.php platform install; card hints are in application/config/snap.php; the
assistant uses Claude when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set (else it answers from the cards' names, without a model).
Changes only ever run from a Confirm the person clicks (Caligrafy\Snap\Consent).

**Parameters**

+ `$options` `array`, default `array()`: 'assistant' (the path of the assistant, '/assistant'), 'cards' (the path of the cards, '/snap')

Source: [framework/core/Route.php:445](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Route.php#L445)

<a name="route-form"></a>
### `Route::form()`

```php
public static function form($route, $capability, array $options = array())
```

A form without a controller (2.19.0, Caligrafy\Form): the form's POST calls a capability, then redirects

```
Route::page('/books/new', 'Books/new');
Route::form('/books', 'create_book', ['success' => '/books/{id}', 'flash' => 'Book added']);
Route::form('/books/{id}', 'update_book', ['method' => 'PUT', 'success' => '/books/{id}']);
```

GET stays a Route::page. Options: 'method' (POST, PUT or DELETE, or a list; default POST), 'success' (a path with
{placeholders} from the result and the route, or a callable($result) returning one; default back), 'flash' (a
message for flash('success'), or [key =&gt; message]), 'back' (where invalid input goes; default the Referer of this
site), 'error' (the message for flash('error') instead of the capability's), 'signIn' (default /login);
2.20.0: 'visitorsOnly' (a path: signed-in people are sent there), 'same' ([field =&gt; [other field, message]]),
'accepted' ([field =&gt; message]: a box that must be ticked), 'inputs' (values only the server sets: an array or a
callable($input)), 'signsIn' (the field of the answer that holds the id of the person to sign in), 'signsInWith'
(how: 'password' by default, what AuthRoutes::signedInBy() answers).
'success' may be a full address, or a callable returning one (a payment page).
Invalid input goes back with errors($field), old($field) and flash('error') for the next page. JSON requests get
the REST answer.

**Parameters**

+ `$route`
+ `$capability`
+ `$options` `array`, default `array()`

Source: [framework/core/Route.php:512](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Route.php#L512)

<a name="route-auth"></a>
### `Route::auth()`

```php
public static function auth(array $options = array())
```

The sign-in pages without a controller (2.19.0, Caligrafy\AuthRoutes): /login, /logout, /register,
/notAuthorized and, with 'passkeys' =&gt; true, the passkey endpoints. Needs Auth::authentication(...) before it.

```
Route::auth(['home' => '/books']);
```

Options: prefix, home ('/'), logout ('/'), register (true, false or the capability), attempts (5), lock (900
seconds), views, passkeys (false), identifier ('username', or the users column people sign in with: 'email'),
signInAfterRegister (false: true signs the new account in and goes 'home'). See AuthRoutes.

**Parameters**

+ `$options` `array`, default `array()`

Source: [framework/core/Route.php:531](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Route.php#L531)

<a name="route-webhook"></a>
### `Route::webhook()`

```php
public static function webhook($route, $capability, array $options = array())
```

Events another service posts (2.19.0, Caligrafy\Webhook): POST only, no CSRF token, the signature checked

```
Route::webhook('/stripe/events', 'record_payment', ['verify' => 'stripe', 'secret_env' => 'STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET']);
Route::webhook('/hooks/github', 'record_push', ['verify' => fn ($raw, $headers) => hash_equals(...)]);
```

The capability gets ['event' =&gt; the decoded JSON body] as the system (Context::system('webhook', $path)).

**Parameters**

+ `$route`
+ `$capability`
+ `$options` `array`, default `array()`

Source: [framework/core/Route.php:542](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Route.php#L542)

<a name="route-download"></a>
### `Route::download()`

```php
public static function download($route, $capability, array $options = array())
```

A read-only capability's result as a file (2.19.0, Caligrafy\Download): GET

```
Route::download('/books.csv', 'list_books', ['as' => 'csv', 'filename' => 'books.csv']);
Route::download('/photos.zip', 'list_photo_files', ['as' => 'zip', 'root' => 'public/uploads/photos']);  // 2.22.0
```

Options: 'as' (csv, json or zip: the files the capability lists, under 'root', default public/uploads), 'columns' (2.19.5: the header row, written even with no row), 'filename' (a name or a
callable($result, $input)), 'bom' (bool), 'formulas' (keep
cells that start with = + - @ as they are), 'signIn'. Refusals as Route::page; inputs to fix answer 422 (2.19.5).

**Parameters**

+ `$route`
+ `$capability`
+ `$options` `array`, default `array()`

Source: [framework/core/Route.php:560](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Route.php#L560)

<a name="route-redirect"></a>
### `Route::redirect()`

```php
public static function redirect($from, $to, $status = 302, array $options = array())
```

A GET that sends the visitor elsewhere (2.19.0): no closure, no controller

```
Route::redirect('/', '/books');
Route::redirect('/old/books/{id}', '/books/{id}', 301);
```

{name} in $to takes the route variable of $from (url-encoded). $to is a path of this site or a full http(s) address.

**Parameters**

+ `$from`
+ `$to`
+ `$status` `int`, default `302`: 301, 302 (default), 303, 307 or 308
+ `$options` `array`, default `array()`: 'keepQuery' (2.20.0, true: the query string of the request goes along)

Source: [framework/core/Route.php:575](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Route.php#L575)
